data.title: 战栗的龙卷 · 英雄协会高层公寓念动力浮空主控跨坐
data.description: S级2位最强超能力者的绝对傲娇。龙卷用念动力掀开标志性的黑色高叉开衩长裙，完全浮空跨坐在你的腰间。翠绿色卷曲短发在念动风暴中飘舞，绿色眼眸带着居高临下的凶狠与掩盖不住的浓郁红晕，双手环抱胸前，娇小却极度诱人的身躯被超能力压制着重重下沉——「看清楚了！我的身体……哪里像小孩子了！……给我好好记住这份重量！」
data.location: A市高层防核公寓·暴风雨夜
data.action: 念动力浮空跨坐黑开衩裙掀起，双臂抱胸翠绿卷发飘扬，傲娇怒视主动重压
data.lighting: 绿色念动力照亮近处轮廓，窗外暴雨夜的冷光透入房间
data.promptProse: Inside a high-rise A-City penthouse on a stormy night, Tatsumaki uses her green telekinetic aura to ride astride her partner with her high-slit black dress lifted and parted across her chest. Folding her arms across her ribs while glaring down with a flushed, defiant pout, she glows in emerald psychic light against cold rain-streaked window reflections.
data.nsfwProse: Her high-slit black dress is lifted high around her thighs and parted across her chest as she hovers slightly in telekinetic cowgirl rhythm with her arms folded.
data.animaCaption: Using green telekinetic aura to ride astride her partner with her high-slit black dress lifted and opened across her chest, she folds her arms haughtily and shoots down a flushed, tsundere glare. Cold storm light from the penthouse window clashes with her luminous green psychic glow.
